title: Foo Bar Taxi Data Ingestion
description: Pull January 2024 yellow and green taxi trip data from the NYC TLC public dataset, load into ClickHouse with a well-designed schema, and handle common data quality issues.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must fetch NYC taxi trip parquet files from a public source, design an appropriate ClickHouse schema, and load millions of rows while handling data quality issues such as null passenger counts, zero-distance trips, and negative fares.

tasks.description: Download January 2024 yellow and green taxi trip parquet files from the NYC TLC dataset, design a ClickHouse schema, clean data quality issues, and load into a single unified table.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse running but empty. Agent must fetch parquet data from the NYC TLC public dataset and load it.
